title: loam run metrics --json
description: The run metrics of one window and of the window before it, of the same length. A landed run counts in the window that it landed in. All times are wall time.

current.description: The window from --since, or from 30 days ago, up to now.

previous.description: The window of the same length that ends where current starts.

spread.description: The median and the 90th percentile of some times, in seconds, by the nearest rank. Both are 0 when count is 0.

landed.description: The runs that landed in the window.

first_pass.description: The landed runs that used no try and no review try.

fixed.description: The landed runs that a later run fixes, unless the fix is cancelled.

lead_time.description: From approve to landed. A run with no draft starts when Loam records it.

stations.description: The time of the landed runs at each station. Each spread holds every landed run, except approve: it holds only the runs that had a draft.

recovery.description: From a failure that started in the window to the next pass.

gate.description: From a failed gate until the run ships, or is Ready.

ci.description: From a failed CI until the run is Ready again.

rework.description: The sums of the loops of the landed runs.

code_review_rounds.description: The code reviews before a push that found a Critical or Major issue.

redrafts.description: The drafts after the first one.

slowest.description: The landed runs with the longest lead time, longest first, at most 5.

not_landed.description: The runs that ended, or wait for you, in the window with no land, by state.
